docTitle: Claude Prompts To Land a Job
source: Prompts written by WithHammad; prompting practice per platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/overview (checked 1 Nov 2026)
reference: AI Central, "Claude Prompts To Land a Job" (11 pages), linkedin.com/company/chat-gpt-central; content credit Elizaveta Zabrodskaya

instagram.sub: 8 copy-paste prompts to land your next job

instagram.title: 8 prompts to *speed up your job search*
instagram.get: a role, your inputs and a clear output in every prompt

instagram.title: Tailor your CV
instagram.what: Match your real experience to the job post
instagram.prompt: You are a senior recruiter for [ROLE]. Job post: [PASTE JOB POST]. My CV: [PASTE CV]. Rewrite my CV for this job: reorder bullets, mirror the post's keywords, sharpen results I already list. Don't invent experience or numbers. Output: the new CV, then the 5 biggest gaps in a table.

instagram.title: Write your cover letter
instagram.bestFor: Roles where a letter is read
instagram.prompt: Act as the hiring manager at [COMPANY]. Using my CV [PASTE CV] and this job post [PASTE JOB POST], write a cover letter under 250 words: a hook tied to the company, 2 proof points from my real experience, a clear close. Plain, confident tone, no cliches. Don't invent anything. Then list 3 lines I should personalize.

instagram.title: Prepare for interviews
instagram.prompt: You are interviewing me for [ROLE] at [COMPANY]. Job post: [PASTE JOB POST]. Ask one question at a time, mixing behavioral and role-specific ones. After each answer: score it 1-10, say what's missing, and show a stronger STAR version using only facts I gave. After 8 questions, name my 3 weakest areas.

instagram.title: Build better connections
instagram.prompt: Write 3 LinkedIn connection notes to [NAME], [THEIR ROLE] at [COMPANY]. My background: [2 LINES ABOUT ME]. Why them: [SHARED LINK, POST OR INTEREST]. Each 2-3 sentences, specific to them, no job ask in the first message, ending with an easy question. Then a short follow-up for 1 week after they accept.

instagram.title: Negotiate your offer
instagram.what: A counter-offer email and a call script
instagram.prompt: Act as a salary negotiation coach. Offer: [BASE, BONUS, EQUITY, BENEFITS] for [ROLE] in [CITY]. My target: [NUMBER], because [REASONS, OTHER OFFERS]. Give me: 1) a polite counter-offer email, 2) a 30-second call script, 3) answers to 3 likely pushbacks. Use only facts I gave and flag what I should check against market data.

instagram.title: Turn rejection into opportunity
instagram.what: Follow up and keep the door open
instagram.prompt: I was rejected for [ROLE] at [COMPANY] after [STAGE]. Write a short, gracious reply that thanks them, asks for one piece of feedback and keeps the door open for future roles. Under 120 words, no bitterness, no begging. Then give me 3 questions to ask myself about what to improve before my next application.

instagram.title: Build your job-search plan
instagram.prompt: Be my job-search coach. Target: [ROLE] in [INDUSTRY / CITY]. I have [HOURS] hours a week for [WEEKS] weeks. Build a weekly plan as a table: day, task, time, goal (applications, outreach, interview prep, skills). Keep the numbers realistic for my hours and add a weekly review checklist. Ask me up to 3 questions first if anything is unclear.

instagram.title: Research companies
instagram.prompt: I'm applying to [COMPANY] for [ROLE]. Using only what I paste here: [ABOUT PAGE, RECENT NEWS, JOB POST], summarize what they sell, who their customers are, what changed recently, likely challenges for this team, and 5 smart questions to ask in the interview. Mark anything you're unsure of. Don't guess facts that aren't in the text.

instagram.sub: Don't wait for the perfect post.
